method: All-frame technical decode using scan_reel_video.py. Read-only extraction primitives from native_pair_tools.py. Actually viewed 25 full checkpoints and 5 head windows over full source, 15 hand/bag and 15 feet crops, and a sheet of every proposed selected native frame for each source. No source edit or composition performed.
audio_note: Both originals contain AAC. A silent review/export should strip source audio without changing picture timing.
limitations: Thumbnail and checkpoint review cannot establish full normal-speed comfort or every fine contact/identity transition.
All original frames technically decoded, but not every full-resolution frame manually inspected.
Still visual acceptance of residual texture does not mean the attempted texture correction succeeded.
Proposed intervals are source-based candidates; actual neighboring overlap and whole-film review remain required.

metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

shots.approval_scope: Assistant sampled source QA permits an isolated join trial only; not normal-speed full-playback, exact identity proof, user motion approval or publication readiness.

observations.identity: No abrupt face substitution in the inspected sheets. The broad smile settles into a neutral closed-mouth expression and the head turns toward the walking direction early; facial polish and angle differ from the smiling still. This is a prompt deviation, not proof of exact all-frame identity.
observations.garments: Cream short stand-collar open jacket, white tee and charcoal straight trousers remain readable; length and major seams are stable in samples. Residual approved still texture is not being reclassified as a new failure.
observations.hands_feet: Hands remain separate from the trousers and bag in the 15 detailed checkpoints; no conspicuous extra limb or discontinuous shoe replacement observed. Narrow/crossing steps and some long forward toe presentations remain. Static crops cannot verify every foot-ground contact or finger transition.
observations.bag: Small black shoulder bag stays on the same side and behind the hip; strap attachment remains plausible in samples. Some flex/shape variation occurs with walking.
observations.background: Wall, window frames, masonry joints and paving translate left as the subject walks right. Major lines stay straight in the sampled frames; no sampled rigid-geometry collapse. Lighting changes from mottled shade into more even bright light.
observations.continuous_tracking: Subject remains full-person while background translates; no sampled stop, teleport or exit. Selected every-frame thumbnails show ongoing walking, not normal-speed playback.

join_risks: The first approximately 1.5 seconds have smile/head-angle settling. Recommended interval begins at f48 / 2 seconds.
Incoming from S02 should compare gaze/head height and shoe phase; outgoing to S04 should compare arm phase and background column positions. This source review does not approve either dissolve.
Visible crossfade face/leg/background double outlines are expected if phases differ; use the requested 18-frame overlap and inspect the actual join. Do not claim seamless continuity.

metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

shots.approval_scope: Assistant sampled source QA permits an isolated join trial only; not normal-speed full-playback, exact identity proof, user motion approval or publication readiness.

observations.identity: No abrupt face substitution in inspected sheets. The opening smile shifts toward neutral, with a brief lowered gaze around 2–2.5 seconds and a gradual turn toward frame-right. Later face appears narrower/more profile and more polished than first frame; this remains a visible angle/expression/appearance change, not exact identity proof.
observations.garments: White short-sleeve pointed-collar tucked shirt and black calf-length A-line skirt remain distinguishable. Skirt hem swings with strides and does not switch to trousers or a different neckline in inspected samples. Residual approved still texture remains an accepted still fact.
observations.hands_feet: Detailed checkpoints show two arms/hands and separate black low block-heel shoes with plausible alternating lift/contact poses; no conspicuous duplicated limbs observed. Narrow crossing steps remain; some shoe toe/heel shape variability can be perspective and is not declared perfect geometry.
observations.bag: Cobalt bag remains visible on the same side. Soft silhouette and opening fold vary with the walking angle; no disappearance or switch of color in samples.
observations.background: Pale wall, window mullions, masonry joints and later revealed steps/door panels stay substantially rigid in samples and translate with the track. Previously unseen architecture is generated continuation, not a verified real location. No sampled severe bending/flowing wall.
observations.continuous_tracking: Full shoes and head remain visible; background motion and changing stride continue throughout the selected interval. Later angle is more side-on than S03, so literal identical-camera-view requirement is not fully met.

join_risks: Avoid the initial smile-to-downward-gaze settling by starting f72 / 3 seconds; f72–227 retains 156 native frames.
Camera/subject angle is gradually more side-on, particularly near the selected end. J34/J45 can therefore show changed facial angle/shoulder width even if person size is similar.

Blue bag adds useful visual difference but can produce double outlines against a black bag during dissolve. Skirt hem vs trousers will also intentionally double during overlap; verify comfort on actual joined video.
No exact zero-difference transition or complete five-look acceptance follows from this source QA.
